purpose: Research-only dry replay of narrowly scoped Kyiv live-monitor hardening. No live queue, monitor state, last-run state, metric, canonical history, dashboard, Grafana, Netlify, or production deployment is mutated.

match_refresh_reclassification.rule: Recompute classification when matching_outcome, matched_episode_id, matched_episode_ids, logical/ambiguity state changes, or when stored MATCH_* classification codes disagree with refreshed matching.
match_refresh_reclassification.persistence: Matching metadata, classification reason codes, classification evidence and candidate status are rewritten as one coherent decision.
match_refresh_reclassification.status_guard: Status changes only when the recomputed classifier produces a different outcome.

trusted_contemporaneous_live_lexical_har.punctuation_variation: Whitespace and common punctuation separators are accepted between lexical components.
unchanged_behavior: Existing explosion recognition for «У Києві пролунали вибухи» is unchanged.
Existing contemporaneous recognition for «У Києві лунають повторні вибухи» is preserved.

bounded_episode_level_composition.same_attack_link: Timestamp compatibility alone is insufficient. At least one additional link is required: repeated/series/ongoing attack-sequence wording, a shared weapon family, or tightly timed trusted same-attack context.
bounded_episode_level_composition.deterministic_anchor: Compatible pairs are sorted by gap_seconds, temporal anchor candidate_id, context candidate_id; the first pair anchors the composed verdict.
bounded_episode_level_composition.duplicate_guard: Do not add another strict candidate if the fixed episode already has approved_strict.

anti_overcomposition_guardrails: Never compose across city or matched_episode_id.
Never use retrospective/cumulative/day-summary wording as a temporal anchor or context contributor.
Never promote PVO_ONLY, controlled-blast, or publisher-fulltext-review evidence through composition.
Require the temporal anchor message time and context publication time to fall inside the fixed target episode.
Reject contributor times that overlap a distinct neighboring alert episode.
Timestamp/publication proximity by itself cannot establish same attack.
Do not transfer locality from one event to another or create duplicate strict events.
